notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and cover core logic, API integration, testing, and domain orchestration.

EVAL-F-03-S84.title: Implement Clinical Trials Orchestration Logic
EVAL-F-03-S84.description: Implement facade method to orchestrate clinical trials search by invoking ClinicalTrialsService, applying recruiting filters, enriching with travel distance and formatting results for UI consumption.

EVAL-F-03-S85.title: Implement Provider Detail Orchestration Logic
EVAL-F-03-S85.description: Implement facade method to orchestrate provider detail lookup via NPI, aggregating CMS registry data, state medical board links, and research site URLs into a unified response.

EVAL-F-03-S86.title: Expose Facade via Tool Router Integration
EVAL-F-03-S86.description: Integrate EvaluateCare facade methods into the tool_router allowlist, ensuring validated inputs are routed correctly and responses are injected into the conversational tool-use loop.

EVAL-F-03-S87.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F-03-S87.description: Create unit and integration tests validating facade orchestration for both clinical trials and provider detail flows, including success paths, validation failures, and external service edge cases.

EVAL-F-03-S88.title: End-to-End Orchestration Validation in Chat Flow
EVAL-F-03-S88.description: Validate that EvaluateCare facade correctly participates in end-to-end chat interactions, ensuring responses are properly formatted, injected into chat history, and aligned with UAT scenarios.
